column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset. Guards cleat#1447: the reaper reclaims a RUNNING row with a stale heartbeat and must NOT reclaim the same row once parked. The arms have to exist even where they skip, because ReapStaleInstances is a separate hand-written statement per dialect and the mssql one is where this went wrong -- it was reverted in #1448 for failing on CI's SQL Server specifically. Note this test carried NO ledger line before the revert, which is part of why its cost was invisible.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: same test, same two arms, and the cluster job runs ./engine/... too, so these lines move together. Same measurement and reason as the test-go/engine line above; see cleat#1447.
